{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensory impulse lines''' were synthetic nerves that were used to give an individual a sense of touch. Sensory impulse lines were placed just beneath the covering of [[Cybernetics/Legends|Cybernetics]], and provided electronic signals that mimicked a real sense of touch.
